title: Stage arrow-key nudge: move selected objects 1px (or 8px with Shift) via keyboard
description:
Flash 8 allows the user to move selected stage objects by 1 pixel using the Arrow keys (Up/Down/Left/Right), and by 8 pixels when Shift is held. This is a core authoring workflow feature used constantly. It is currently absent: the global `onKeyDown` handler in `Shell.tsx` (around line 3182) handles zoom, rulers, grid, panels, Escape, and Ctrl+Enter but has no arrow-key nudge logic.

## What to implement

In the `onKeyDown` handler in `Shell.tsx`, add handling for:
- `ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / ArrowUp / ArrowDown` (without any modifier) → move selected display objects by 1px in that direction
- Same keys + Shift → move by 8px (Flash 8 default large-nudge)
- Only fire when the active tool is the Arrow (Selection) tool, no modal dialog is open, and focus is not inside a text input, textarea, or the Actions panel editor

The move should:
1. Apply to all currently selected objects (`selectedShapeId` or multi-selection if that state exists)
2. Translate `x`/`y` on the matching `DisplayObject` in the active keyframe of the active layer
3. Push the mutation via `pushDoc` so it is undoable
4. Call `e.preventDefault()` to prevent the browser from scrolling

## Files likely touched
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx` — add arrow-key cases to the keydown handler
- `packages/core/src/engine/` — may need a `nudgeDisplayObject` helper or reuse the existing `withDisplayObjectUpdate` pattern

## Acceptance
- Select a shape or symbol instance with the Arrow tool, press ArrowRight → object moves 1px to the right
- Hold Shift+ArrowDown → object moves 8px downward
- Both moves are undo-able (Ctrl+Z restores previous position)
- Works for shapes, text fields, and symbol instances
